key.name: last-folder
key.description: The path of the folder last opened by the user.

key.name: visual-search-gpu
key.summary: Index visual search on the graphics card
key.description: Whether visual-search indexing uses an installed GPU build of llama-server, falling back to the processor when no graphics card has room.

key.name: metadata-visible
key.description: Whether the floating metadata overlay is shown in the viewer.

key.name: library-root
key.description: If set, sidebar scans this path instead of ~/Pictures.

key.name: libraries-json
key.description: JSON-encoded list of named libraries and their folder settings.

key.name: active-library-id
key.description: The id of the currently selected library.

key.name: last-bucket
key.description: JSON library identity and bucket id for the repeat-add action.

key.name: webp-export-dir
key.summary: Folder for WebP exports and crop copies
key.description: If empty, ~/Pictures/Wallpapers.

key.name: webp-export-lossless
key.description: Lossless keeps every pixel; otherwise the quality setting applies.

key.name: webp-export-quality
key.description: From 1 to 100, used when lossless export is off.

key.name: webp-export-fit
key.description: Shrink larger images to fit within the fit width and height; never enlarge.

key.name: webp-export-fit-width
key.description: Width of the box exports are fitted within.

key.name: webp-export-fit-height
key.description: Height of the box exports are fitted within.

key.name: resize-output-dir
key.description: If set, resized copies save here instead of ~/Pictures/Resized.

key.name: upscaler-binary-path
key.description: Override the auto-detected backend binary location.

key.name: upscaled-output-dir
key.summary: Custom folder for saved upscaled images
key.description: If set, upscaled images save here instead of ~/Pictures/Upscaled.

key.name: export-output-dir
key.summary: Custom folder for saved exported images
key.description: If set, exported/downscaled images save here instead of ~/Pictures/Export.

key.name: upscaler-default-model
key.description: Either "standard" or "anime".

key.name: upscaler-output-format
key.description: Legacy migration key from earlier Sharpr versions.

key.name: upscale-compress-output
key.description: If enabled, Sharpr re-encodes the final PNG result into the selected compressed format.

key.name: upscale-compressed-format
key.description: One of "jxl", "webp", or "jpeg".

key.name: upscale-keep-raw-png-sidecar
key.summary: Keep raw PNG sidecar after compression
key.description: If enabled, Sharpr keeps the raw PNG alongside the compressed upscale result.

key.name: upscaler-compression-mode
key.description: One of "auto", "lossy", or "lossless".

key.name: upscaler-quality
key.description: Lossy encoder quality target used for JPEG XL, WebP, or JPEG output.

key.name: upscaler-tile-size
key.description: Tile size passed to the Vulkan backend; 0 means auto.

key.name: upscaler-gpu-id
key.description: GPU device passed to the Vulkan backend; -1 means auto.

key.name: thumbnail-cache-max
key.description: Maximum number of thumbnails to hold in memory.

key.name: smart-tagger-model
key.description: The ONNX model used for smart tagging.

key.name: show-upscale-ui
key.summary: Show AI upscale in the primary UI
key.description: Whether the main menu exposes the AI upscale action.

key.name: upscale-backend
key.description: One of "cli" (Vulkan subprocess) or "onnx" (ORT/Swin2SR).

key.name: onnx-upscale-model
key.description: Model used by the ONNX upscale backend.

key.name: comfyui-url
key.description: Base URL of the local ComfyUI server.

key.name: comfyui-workflow
key.description: One of "esrgan" or "seedvr2".

key.name: comfyui-enabled
key.description: Show ComfyUI as an option in the upscale backend selector.

key.name: pipeline-history-cap
key.description: Maximum number of completed and failed jobs to retain. Oldest entries are pruned automatically.
